profiles.source: shipped default: the adopted pancake flags that are ported to this branch (ledger ids from pancake-strata TEST_LEDGER.md), minus every flag the 2026-11-19 box measurements of this branch found FAIL / NO-GAIN / UNSUPPORTED (except the text-identity UNSUPPORTED of the three RDNA kernels, restored by owner decision 2026-11-20) or lossy without a passing gate (top-level "removed", owner order 2026-11-19 23:05); regenerate with tools/pancake/flag_diag.sh --write-recommended after the box benchmark

flags.name: STRATA_RDNA_Q6K
flags.ledger: T-079 (microbench), T-081 (confirm edit +4.3% +-5.0, text identical; inside noise), T-009
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): the diag's 'claimed exact but the text differs' is not a verdict here, because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19; exactness is judged by the parity ctests (rdna_mmvq_parity), not run on the box yet

flags.name: STRATA_GR_RDNA
flags.ledger: T-009 (RDNA kernel bundle: decode 87-101 -> 104-108 tok/s; 3.0 = 104 against 101, a bound for the bundle, not a per-flag number)
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): the diag's 'claimed exact but the text differs' is not a verdict here, because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19; exactness is judged by the parity ctests (rdna_gr_parity), not run on the box yet

flags.name: STRATA_RDNA_MMVQ_WAVE
flags.ledger: T-009 (same bundle bound), T-072 (mode 1 is 4.5% slower than 3 on short)
flags.exactness: EXACT-UNVERIFIED on this model (owner decision 2026-11-20): the diag's 'claimed exact but the text differs' is not a verdict here, because plain upstream against itself (base-late) also gave DIFFERENT text in every run of 2026-11-19; exactness is judged by the parity ctests (none registered), not run on the box yet

removed.name: STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING
removed.evidence: flag_diag rerun on the box 2026-11-19 (/home/dan/auto-runs/winbenchus/diag-rerun/diag-plain/verdicts.json, the plain upstream build): UNSUPPORTED, "claimed exact but the text differs from the default here". Note 2026-11-20: the same text-identity reason the owner ruled invalid for the RDNA kernels; it stays out pending an owner decision

removed.name: --lookup-max-t
removed.evidence: lossy (exact false); the quality gate of this branch did not pass: /home/dan/auto-runs/benchexact/gate-us (spec 222, 48 requests, token forcing against plain upstream v0.2.16): updated-exact (which keeps --lookup-max-t 12) REJECT on the rate rule, mismatch 3.379% against 1.562% / 1.360% for two stock runs, +1.92 points, 90% interval [+1.23, +2.74]; updated REJECT (3.964%, +2.50 points); event rule PASS for both. AGENTS.md: never lossy without a passing gate. The pancake-base PASS (T-126/T-127) does not carry over.

removed_note: Taken out of the gfx1100 profile 2026-11-20 (owner order 2026-11-19 23:05: remove what did not work): every flag with a FAIL / NO-GAIN / UNSUPPORTED verdict on this branch, and every lossy flag whose quality gate did not pass. Not measured as a single flag here and kept: --pcie-frac 0 (exact). Restored 2026-11-20 by owner decision: STRATA_RDNA_Q6K, STRATA_GR_RDNA, STRATA_RDNA_MMVQ_WAVE (their UNSUPPORTED came from text identity, which the default fails against itself on this model). The specs 220-223 measure the whole updated preset (configs/pancake/flashnext-iq2_xs-updated-hip.json), not this file.
